quests.instruction: Give an overview, then say where the table is, then add the rows of plants behind it.
quests.hint: Start with the setting, then place the table, then add the plants and the tree.
quests.explanation: This task links overview, location, and supporting details in three parts, which is the core pattern of organized description.
quests.sceneText: Vineyard Terrace|rows of grapevines|table set with glasses|old olive tree
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a vineyard terrace overlooking the hills. In the center there's a wooden table set with glasses, and rows of grapevines run down the slope behind it. An old olive tree stands at the end of the terrace.

quests.instruction: Give an overview, say where the fireplace is, then add the seating and the boots.
quests.hint: Name the room first, then the main feature, then the smaller details.
quests.explanation: The learner leads with the room type and then the feature that anchors the space (the fireplace), followed by the supporting items.
quests.sceneText: Chalet Lounge|leather sofas facing the fire|ski boots by the door|stone fireplace on the far wall
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a ski chalet lounge. A stone fireplace stands against the far wall, two leather sofas face it, and a pair of ski boots is lined up by the door.
acceptedSynonyms: ski boots,boots by the door,pair of boots

quests.instruction: Give an overview, then the main desk, then the supporting details around it.
quests.hint: Set the scene first, then name the desk and where the other two things are.
quests.explanation: This is a light task: overview, main object, supporting objects, in that order, with each object linked by place.
quests.sceneText: School Reception|welcome desk|world map on the wall|brochure rack near the door
quests.sampleAnswer: This is the reception of a language school. The welcome desk is in the center, a world map covers the wall behind it, and a brochure rack stands near the door.
acceptedSynonyms: world map,map on the wall,wall map

quests.instruction: Start with the most important detail, then mention smaller ones.
quests.hint: Decide what matters most, say it first, and add the small items after.
quests.explanation: Prioritizing the important detail first is a real skill: a listener remembers the first thing you say, so it should be the key one.
quests.sceneText: Broken Window|broom leaning on the wall|ladder beside the window|broken window with glass on the floor
quests.sampleAnswer: The most important thing is the broken window, with glass all over the floor. A ladder is set up beside it, and a broom is leaning against the wall.
options: Broken window with glass on the floor
acceptedSynonyms: broken window,shattered window,window with glass on the floor
quests.correctAnswer: Broken window with glass on the floor

quests.instruction: Start with the problem, then the objects used to deal with it.
quests.hint: Say what the main problem is, then what is placed to deal with it.
quests.explanation: The learner reports a visible problem first and then the objects around it, which is a natural order when telling someone about a situation.
quests.sceneText: Leaking Ceiling|towel on the floor|stained ceiling with a drip|bucket under the leak
quests.sampleAnswer: The main thing is a stained ceiling with water dripping from one spot. A bucket is placed under it, and a towel is spread on the floor.
acceptedSynonyms: towel,towel on the floor,cloth on the floor
stained ceiling,ceiling with a drip,leaking ceiling

quests.instruction: Start with the detail that explains the long line, then describe the line.
quests.hint: Start with the sign, then the line, then the one person still using the machine.
quests.explanation: Choosing the most informative detail first (the sign) lets the listener understand the scene right away.
quests.sceneText: Ticket Machine Line|person tapping the screen|long line of people|out-of-order sign
quests.sampleAnswer: The most important detail is a sign on the machine saying it is out of order. A long line of people is waiting beside it, and one person is tapping the screen anyway.
acceptedSynonyms: person tapping,person at the screen,person at the machine
out-of-order sign,sign on the machine,broken machine sign

quests.instruction: Divide the hall into two zones and describe the left zone first.
quests.hint: Name the zone first ('On the left side'), then what is happening there.
quests.explanation: Splitting a scene into zones lets the learner give a big scene a clear structure, then fill in what happens in each part.
quests.sceneText: Sports Hall|badminton game on the left|volleyball game on the right|scoreboard in the middle
quests.sampleAnswer: On the left side of the hall, two people are playing badminton. On the right side, a group is playing volleyball, and a scoreboard hangs in the middle.

quests.instruction: Describe the apartment as three zones and end with the middle zone.
quests.hint: Name the left, right, and middle zones in that order, and save the middle for last.
quests.explanation: Naming zones makes an open space easy to understand, and saving the middle for last shows how the parts connect.
quests.sceneText: Open-Plan Apartment|kitchen area with a stove|lounge area with a sofa|dining table in the middle
quests.sampleAnswer: The apartment is one open space. On the left there's a kitchen area with a stove, on the right a lounge with a sofa, and in the middle a dining table connects the two.
acceptedSynonyms: kitchen area,kitchen with a stove,stove area
dining table,table in the middle,middle table

quests.instruction: Describe the shop in zones and say what is in the section on the right.
quests.hint: Go from left to front to right, and give one object for each zone.
quests.explanation: The learner divides a shop into left, right, and front zones, then names the main object in each.
quests.sceneText: Outdoor Store|wall of running shoes on the left|display of tents on the right|cash desk at the front
quests.sampleAnswer: On the left there's a wall of running shoes, on the right a display of tents, and at the front there's a cash desk.

quests.instruction: Describe the picnic: the blanket in the center, what is nearby, and what is farther along the bank.
quests.hint: Use 'nearby' for the dog and 'farther along' for the children.
quests.explanation: 'Nearby' and 'farther along' separate close details from distant ones, so the learner can order objects by how far they are from the center.
quests.sceneText: Riverbank Picnic|dog resting nearby|blanket with food|children skipping stones farther along the bank
quests.sampleAnswer: In the center there's a blanket with food on it. A dog is resting nearby, and farther along the bank, two children are skipping stones.
acceptedSynonyms: children skipping stones,kids by the water,children on the bank

quests.instruction: Start with the statue, then add what is nearby and what is across the square.
quests.hint: Use 'in the center', 'nearby', and 'across the square' in order.
quests.explanation: Three levels of distance (in the center, nearby, across) give the listener a sense of how far each object is.
quests.sceneText: Statue in the Square|bronze statue|pigeons gathered nearby|bakery across the square
quests.sampleAnswer: A bronze statue stands in the center of the square. Pigeons are gathered nearby on the stones, and a bakery is visible across the square.
acceptedSynonyms: bakery,shop across the square,bakery across the square

quests.instruction: Start with the animal closest to the fence, then move outward.
quests.hint: Use 'near', 'a little further away', and 'off to the side'.
quests.explanation: 'A little further away' and 'off to the side' extend the description outward from a starting point, which is a common organizing move.
quests.sceneText: Wildlife Reserve|giraffe near the fence|zebras a little further away|trees off to the side
quests.sampleAnswer: A giraffe is standing near the fence. A little further away, a group of zebras is grazing, and off to the side there are a few trees.
acceptedSynonyms: trees,trees to the side,a few trees

quests.instruction: Describe who is in each area of the room and what they are doing, finishing with the mat area.
quests.hint: Use 'in the center', 'on the right', and 'in the corner' for the three groups.
quests.explanation: The learner describes three groups of people in three areas, with one action for each, and ends with the person on the mat.
quests.sceneText: Community Center Gym|group doing aerobics in the center|man lifting weights on the right|woman stretching on a mat in the corner
quests.sampleAnswer: In the center, a group is doing aerobics. On the right, a man is lifting weights, and in the corner, a woman is stretching on a mat.
acceptedSynonyms: woman stretching,woman on a mat,woman stretching on a mat

quests.instruction: Describe the field by areas: who is on the track, in the sandpit, and on the grass. Start with the people on the track.
quests.hint: Give one area and one action for each person or group.
quests.explanation: Location plus action for three different people or groups is a compact way to describe a sports scene.
quests.sceneText: Athletics Field|runners on the track|jumper in the sandpit|thrower on the grass
quests.sampleAnswer: On the track, several runners are racing around the bend. In the sandpit, a jumper is landing, and on the grass a thrower is swinging his arm back.

quests.instruction: Describe what is happening in three parts of the waiting area; start with the child.
quests.hint: Give a place and an action for each person; start with the middle.
quests.explanation: The learner moves through a room by person and area, so the description feels like a tour instead of a list.
quests.sceneText: Departure Hall Seating|passenger lying on a bench|child playing on the floor|man talking on the phone
quests.sampleAnswer: On the left, a passenger is lying on a bench with his bag under his head. In the middle, a child is playing on the floor, and near the window a man is talking on the phone.
acceptedSynonyms: passenger on a bench,man lying down,person resting
child playing,child on the floor,kid playing
man on the phone,man talking on the phone,man near the window

quests.instruction: Guide the listener's eye with 'first', 'next', and 'finally', starting with the largest item.
quests.hint: Use 'First', 'Next', and 'Finally' to walk the eye across the wall.
quests.explanation: Sequence words guide the listener's attention, so the learner controls where a listener looks first, next, and last.
quests.sceneText: Hallway Wall|row of small frames on the left|round wall clock above the door|large mirror in the center
quests.sampleAnswer: First, the large mirror in the center catches your eye. Next, there's a row of small frames on the left, and finally a round wall clock hangs above the door.
acceptedSynonyms: wall clock,round clock,clock above the door

quests.instruction: Guide the listener's eye: first the largest attraction, then the rows, then the boxes.
quests.hint: Use 'First', 'Next', and 'Finally' for the fountain, the truffles, and the boxes.
quests.explanation: The order of attention (largest, then rows, then boxes) is set by the speaker, which is a skill in real display or product descriptions.
quests.sceneText: Chocolate Shop Window|rows of truffles on trays|gift boxes with ribbons|chocolate fountain in the middle
quests.sampleAnswer: First, there's a chocolate fountain in the middle of the window. Next, rows of truffles are lined up on trays, and finally gift boxes with ribbons are stacked at the front.

quests.instruction: Guide the listener's eye from the entrance to the far end using 'first', 'then', and 'finally'.
quests.hint: Move in the direction someone would walk: entrance, middle, below.
quests.explanation: The learner uses the direction of walking to order the description, and 'finally' marks the last detail.
quests.sceneText: Footbridge|sign at the entrance|walkers crossing the bridge|boats passing below
quests.sampleAnswer: First, there's a sign at the entrance to the bridge. Then a few walkers are crossing in the middle, and finally, boats are passing below.
acceptedSynonyms: boats,boats passing below,boats on the water

quests.instruction: Describe what is at the top of the picture, at the bottom, and at the edge. Start with what is at the top.
quests.hint: Use 'at the top', 'at the bottom', and 'at the right edge' to describe the frame.
quests.explanation: Describing a picture by frame position ('at the top of the picture') is a different skill from describing a real space, and it is useful for photos.
quests.sceneText: Winter Garden Photo|bird feeder at the right edge|small bird on a branch at the top|snow covering the ground
quests.sampleAnswer: At the top of the picture, a small bird is sitting on a branch. At the bottom, snow covers the ground, and at the right edge a bird feeder is hanging.
options: Bird feeder at the right edge

quests.instruction: Describe a top-down photo: the center first, then the edge, then the corner.
quests.hint: Say what is in the center, then the edge, then the corner.
quests.explanation: A photo taken from above needs center, edge, and corner words instead of left and right, which is a new way to organize position.
quests.sceneText: Blanket From Above|basket of sandwiches in the center|straw hat at the edge|sunglasses in the corner
quests.sampleAnswer: In the center of the photo there's a basket of sandwiches. At the edge of the blanket, a straw hat is lying upside down, and in the corner there's a pair of sunglasses.

quests.instruction: Describe the view through the window: what is at the edge, in the middle, and at the bottom. Focus on what is in the middle of the frame.
quests.hint: Go from edge to middle to bottom, using one detail for each.
quests.explanation: Framing words (edge, middle, bottom) give the learner a way to describe a cropped view, like a window or a photo.
quests.sceneText: Window View|curtain at the left edge|tree outside the window|rooftops at the bottom
quests.sampleAnswer: At the left edge of the frame, a curtain is pulled back. In the middle, a tree grows outside the window, and at the bottom, rooftops stretch into the distance.
acceptedSynonyms: tree,tree outside the window,tree in the middle

quests.instruction: Give an overview, then contrast the two sides of the street and mention what connects them.
quests.hint: Set the scene, then contrast the left and right, then name what joins them.
quests.explanation: Contrasting two areas with 'while' and then naming a connecting feature gives the description a real structure.
quests.sceneText: Street with Two Sides|crowded market stalls on the left|row of quiet houses on the right|narrow alley between them
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a street with two very different sides. On the left, market stalls are crowded together, while on the right there's a row of quiet houses with closed doors. A narrow alley runs between them.
options: Crowded market stalls on the left
Row of quiet houses on the right
acceptedSynonyms: market stalls,crowded stalls,stalls on the left
quiet houses,row of houses,houses on the right

quests.instruction: Give an overview, then start with the active side of the yard and contrast it with the other side.
quests.hint: Name the two areas, contrast them with 'while', and end with the marking on the ground.
quests.explanation: 'On one side ... on the other' is a natural contrast structure for two areas of the same space.
quests.sceneText: School Yard|football game on one side|reading benches on the other side|hopscotch grid painted on the ground
quests.sampleAnswer: The school yard is divided into two areas. On one side, a group is playing football, while on the other side a few children are reading on benches. A hopscotch grid is painted on the ground between them.

quests.instruction: Give an overview, then contrast the two kinds of seating, and focus on the seating at the back.
quests.hint: Start with 'This is a restaurant with two kinds of seating', then contrast.
quests.explanation: The learner contrasts two seating areas by their lighting, and names the bar counter as the divider.
quests.sceneText: Restaurant Interior|window tables in daylight|booths with low hanging lamps|bar counter in the middle
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a restaurant with two kinds of seating. Near the windows, tables are lit by daylight, while at the back the booths have low hanging lamps. A bar counter separates the two areas.

quests.instruction: Give an overview, then the main group, then the leader and the background.
quests.hint: Say what it is, describe the group, and end with the leader and the trees.
quests.explanation: The learner uses the full organized structure: overview, main group, leader, and background.
quests.sceneText: Outdoor Yoga Class|group on yoga mats|woman leading at the front|trees in the background
quests.sampleAnswer: This is an outdoor yoga class in a park. About ten people are kneeling on mats in rows, a woman at the front is demonstrating a pose, and tall trees fill the background.
acceptedSynonyms: group on mats,people on yoga mats,yoga group

quests.instruction: Give an overview, then describe the banner and the crowd, and end with the main group.
quests.hint: Save the main group of cyclists for your last sentence.
quests.explanation: The learner saves the main group for last, which makes a clear reveal: setting, background, then the main subject.
quests.sceneText: Race Start|banner over the road|crowd along the barriers|cyclists lined up at the start
quests.sampleAnswer: This is the start of a cycling race. A banner stretches over the road, crowds are standing along the barriers, and the cyclists are lined up at the start with one foot on the ground.
options: Cyclists lined up at the start
acceptedSynonyms: cyclists,cyclists lined up,riders at the start
quests.correctAnswer: Cyclists lined up at the start

quests.instruction: Give an overview, then the main people, then the guests and the background.
quests.hint: Overview first, then the couple, then the guests, then what is behind them.
quests.explanation: A busy celebration is easier to follow when the learner names the main people first and the crowd and background after.
quests.sceneText: Wedding Steps|guests throwing petals|couple on the steps|open doors behind them
quests.sampleAnswer: This looks like a wedding celebration. A couple is standing on the steps in the center, guests on both sides are throwing petals, and open wooden doors are visible behind them.
acceptedSynonyms: couple,couple on the steps,bride and groom

quests.instruction: Describe the entrance in six sentences: overview, location, main features, people, supporting details, and background. Make the people moving toward the gates your main focus.
quests.hint: Give each of the six sentences one job: overview, location, main feature, people, side details, background.
quests.explanation: Level 100 marks the end of the organization block: the learner produces a six-sentence description that follows a planned order.
quests.sceneText: Amusement Park Entrance|large arched sign|crowd of visitors|row of ticket gates
quests.sampleAnswer: This is the entrance to an amusement park. A large arched sign stretches over the main gate, and below it a row of ticket gates stands open. A crowd of visitors is moving toward the gates, and some are holding tickets. On the left, a small kiosk sells balloons, while on the right there's a map board. In the background, the top of a Ferris wheel is visible above the trees.
acceptedSynonyms: crowd of visitors,visitors,people at the gates

quests.instruction: Describe the terrace in six sentences: overview, tables, people, nearby details, and the view. Start with the furniture arranged in rows.
quests.hint: Give each sentence one job, and finish with the view beyond the railing.
quests.explanation: This final task uses overview, main features, people, side details, and background in one organized six-sentence answer.
quests.sceneText: Riverside Terrace|tables with white tablecloths|man carrying plates|boat on the river
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a riverside restaurant terrace. Tables with white tablecloths are arranged in three rows, and most of them are occupied. A man is carrying plates between the tables, while a group at the far end is raising their glasses. Along the edge of the terrace, there are potted lemon trees. Beyond the railing, a boat is passing on the river.
acceptedSynonyms: man carrying plates,man with plates,man serving

quests.instruction: Describe the pond in six sentences and finish with the trees in the background.
quests.hint: Use a different position phrase in each sentence, and save the trees for last.
quests.explanation: The learner ends the block with a six-sentence description that combines people, objects, position, and background in a planned order.
quests.sceneText: Skating Pond|skaters gliding around the edge|small hockey net|snow-covered pine trees
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a frozen pond used for skating. Several skaters are gliding around the edge in the same direction, and a small hockey net stands near the middle. A boy in a red hat is lacing his skates on a bench. Near the shore, there's a stand selling hot drinks with a short line in front. At the far side, snow-covered pine trees rise behind the pond.
